description:
About the job

Company Introduction

WorldStrides is the global leader in educational travel and experiential learning. The company was founded in 1967 to provide middle school travel programs to Washington, D.C. and has grown to provide a wide range of programs for more than half a million students annually to over 100 countries around the world. WorldStrides offers experiential learning programs in educational travel, performing arts, language immersion, career exploration, service-learning, study abroad, and sports. Each of these experiences helps students to see beyond the classroom and to see the world – and themselves – in new ways.

Job Description

The Business Development Representative (BDR) / Lead Qualifier is responsible for generating new business opportunities through high-volume outbound calls and email outreach to schools and teachers across the U.S.

In this role, you will: Proactively prospect and engage educators to introduce WorldStrides programs, qualify leads by identifying teachers interested in organizing student travel experiences, consistently meet and exceed monthly targets for calls and qualified leads, and collaborate with the Sales team by passing high-quality opportunities for closing.

This is a goal-driven, outbound sales role where success depends on your ability to handle rejection and stay motivated, build rapport quickly over the phone, maintain strong activity levels daily, and meet weekly and monthly goals in order to achieve additional compensation through a set commission structure.

You’ll work with a wide range of educational travel programs (history, science, national parks, and more), giving you constant opportunities to connect with new prospects and refine your sales and communication skills.

Responsibilities


Make calls and leave messages for teachers nationwide and use talk tracks for live calls.
Send follow-up emails.
Work on special projects, including periodic competitive calls, calls to unassigned schools, specialty schools and other telemarketing efforts.
Periodically research schools to help identify top prospects and maintain the database. Use templates to create and send flyers and update PowerPoint presentations.


Qualifications


Desired work experience in sales, marketing, promotions or telemarketing.
Proficiency in relevant computer applications including CRM.
Desired knowledge of customer service/sales principles and practices.
Six months or more experience in sales/lead creation/lead qualifying with Telephone sales experience preferred
Good data entry/keyboard skills
Familiar with office rules/office environment
High school diploma or GED required
Advanced (85%+) English level
Desired knowledge of sales and marketing principles and strategies
Proactive
Organized


Work Perks


Fun & driven environment.
Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage, life, accidental death and dismemberment, accident, critical illness, and disability insurance.
+10% of gross salary as food stamps.
1 paid volunteer day & 25 PTO* days to start – accrue up to 28 over 3 years, 4 mental health days, and 5 bereavement days.
Statutory Holidays by Mexican Federal Labor Law.
Tuition reimbursement up to five thousand, two hundred fifty dollars annually or one thousand dollars towards professional certification annually.
Flexible work schedule providing on-site and hybrid opportunities.
Encouraged participation in our Employee Resource Groups and Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion council.
Fitness opportunities. Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Paid statutory parental leave.


WorldStrides, a global organization, is committed to educate and serve communities worldwide. Our commitment is fueled by the passion of our team members and partners to make experiential learning accessible, while also being socially, environmentally, and ethically responsible. Together, we accomplish this by investing in initiatives to promote inclusion, diversity, and sustainability.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, WorldStrides is committed to building a diverse workforce, supported by an environment that promotes inclusion and belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

WorldStrides will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1, J-1, H-1, H-2, L, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire. Select seasonal roles may consider students on J-1 or F-1 visas.

The Senior Consultant, Product Marketing role will focus on Mexico while collaborating closely with regional cross-functional teams and global Product Marketing associates. This role reports into the Sr Director, International Product Marketing. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.

Own and lead go-to-market strategies tailored to regional market dynamics, customer needs, and competitive landscapes, with a focus on supporting product launches, sales enablement, market-driven initiatives, and targeted campaigns.

Conduct ongoing market, customer, and competitor analysis to inform positioning, product roadmaps, and differentiated market stories
Influence and align stakeholders across product, sales, market development, and marketing teams to support go-to-market readiness.
Partner with the global Product Marketing team to localize global launches for the Latin American market and leverage best-practice processes and tools.

5+ years of experience in B2B Product Marketing, preferably within SaaS, information services, technology, data, analytics, or related industries.
Demonstrated success developing and executing go-to-market (GTM) strategies, product launches, and commercial growth initiatives.

Strong analytical, commercial, and problem-solving capabilities with experience leveraging market, customer, and competitive insights to influence decisions.

Experience developing and executing Go-to-Market (GTM) strategies for B2B products and solutions.

At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our Workforce for Good, which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

The Social Media CX team is a critical extension of CX Operations, managing customer interactions in high-visibility channels where speed, accuracy, and consistency are key. In this role, you’ll own end-to-end Social Media CX process optimization, focusing on operational response flows, scripts, and playbooks to ensure timely and compliant customer support. Own Social Media CX operational processes end-to-end, from response flows to continuous optimization.

Support critical and sensitive cases through clear operational escalation and resolution processes.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Experience in Social Media Customer Support.
Experience supporting customers through social media platforms.

Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional operational teams.
Business-level English, able to work with internal and regional stakeholders.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

description:
About the job

Senior SEO Specialist – Link Building & Digital PR

Department: Digital Marketing – Sales & Marketing

Reports to: Digital Growth & SEO Strategist

Location: Guadalajara, Mexico / Remote – TBD

Schedule: Full-time, aligned with Pacific Time business hours

Headcount: 1

About The Role

Farahi Law Firm is a California personal injury law firm competing in one of the most aggressive organic search markets in the country.

For us, authority is a major growth lever. This is a senior, hands-on SEO role focused specifically on link building, digital PR, and off-page authority. You will own our off-page SEO strategy end to end—from prospecting and outreach to securing high-quality editorial placements and measuring their impact.

You will work across both our English and Spanish properties, build authority around our priority practice areas and California markets, and mentor our existing Link Builder to raise the quality and effectiveness of our link acquisition efforts.

This is not a technical SEO role. Our in-house development team handles technical SEO implementation and site fixes. Your focus is building the authority that helps our content and pages compete.

What You'll Do

Link Acquisition & Digital PR


Own the off-page SEO roadmap, including target pages, anchor strategy, link velocity, and authority goals by practice area and city.
Personally prospect, pitch, negotiate, and secure high-quality editorial placements.
Build relationships with legal directories, local news outlets, community organizations, industry publications, universities, associations, and other relevant publishers.
Run digital PR and expert-source campaigns similar to HARO/Qwoted, positioning firm attorneys as credible sources for journalists and publishers.
Develop linkable assets in partnership with the content team, including original data studies, safety and claims research, local resource hubs, and statistics pages.
Create and optimize outreach sequences, pitch angles, and follow-up processes that generate repeatable placements.
Build and maintain a pipeline of publishers, journalists, editors, and other relevant contacts.


Local & Geographic Authority


Build citation and local authority for California service-area pages and Google Business Profiles.
Identify sponsorships, community events, partnerships, and local opportunities that can generate legitimate editorial links and brand mentions.
Coordinate with marketing, events, merchandise, and vendor teams to ensure sponsorships and partnerships translate into meaningful online visibility and links.
Identify opportunities to strengthen authority in priority California cities where competitors are outperforming us.


Quality Control & Risk Management


Establish and enforce a clear quality standard for every acquired placement.
Evaluate opportunities based on real traffic, editorial standards, topical relevance, domain quality, and long-term SEO value.
Avoid PBNs, link farms, manipulative link schemes, and placements that could put the domain at risk.
Conduct ongoing backlink audits and identify potentially toxic or spammy links.
Monitor competitor backlink profiles and turn link gaps into actionable prospecting opportunities.
Stay current on Google's link spam policies and evolving off-page SEO best practices.


Team Leadership & Reporting


Mentor and guide our existing Link Builder, including reviewing prospect lists, outreach quality, follow-up processes, and acquired placements.
Establish clear standards and expectations for link acquisition.
Report monthly on qualified links acquired, referring-domain growth, authority movement, and ranking impact.
Work closely with the SEO Content Lead, English and Spanish writers, and reporting team to ensure on-page and off-page strategies support the same priority pages.
Use data to evaluate what is working, what is not, and where we should invest additional effort.


What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days


Complete a comprehensive backlink and competitor gap audit for our English and Spanish properties.
Deliver a prioritized 90-day link acquisition roadmap with named targets and page-level goals.
Establish and document a clear placement quality standard.


First 60 Days


Have an active outreach pipeline with a documented prospect list and tracked response rates.
Secure the first placements on priority pages.
Begin toxic-link identification and cleanup.


First 90 Days & Ongoing


Consistently meet an agreed monthly quota of qualified referring domains.
Demonstrate measurable authority growth across priority practice-area and city pages.
Drive ranking improvements across an agreed target keyword set.
Maintain zero placements that violate search engine guidelines.


Required Qualifications


5+ years of SEO experience, with at least 3 years specifically focused on link building, digital PR, or off-page SEO.
Demonstrated experience personally securing high-quality link placements.
A portfolio or track record of campaigns you can walk us through, including your outreach strategy and measurable outcomes.
Experience in a competitive commercial or YMYL vertical such as legal, medical, finance, insurance, or a comparable industry.
Excellent written English with strong persuasive communication skills. Outreach is a writing job before it is an SEO job.
Strong working knowledge of Ahrefs or Semrush, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics 4.
Experience with outreach and CRM platforms such as Pitchbox, BuzzStream, Hunter, Apollo, or similar tools.
Strong understanding of Google's link spam policies and off-page SEO risk.
Ability to work independently, own strategy, and execute hands-on.
Comfortable being measured on outcomes and communicating performance clearly.


Preferred Qualifications


Bilingual English/Spanish.
Experience marketing a personal injury law firm or other legal services business.
Existing relationships with journalists, editors, publishers, or relevant media contacts in the U.S.
Experience with local SEO, citation building, and multi-location Google Business Profile authority.
Experience developing and promoting original research or data-driven linkable assets.
Experience mentoring or managing junior SEO/link-building professionals.


What We Offer


A senior role with real ownership of a core SEO function, rather than a task-based position.
Direct collaboration with the Digital Growth & SEO Strategist and visibility with firm leadership.
Budget and support for outreach tools, digital PR, and linkable asset production.
An established content, design, and development team to execute against your strategy.
The opportunity to help shape the firm's organic growth strategy across English and Spanish markets.
Growth potential toward broader leadership within the organic search function.


How to Apply

Please Submit Your Resume Along With The Following


 Three link placements you personally secured


For each, briefly explain the placement, your outreach approach, and the impact it had.


 One campaign that did not work


Tell us what you tried, why you believe it failed, and what you changed afterward.


 Your SEO perspective


Where do you believe a California personal injury firm should be earning links that its competitors are not?

If you have personally built links that moved rankings in a competitive market, we want to hear from you.

About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

As a Food Campaigns Senior Analyst at DiDi, you will design, optimize and measure promotional programs across DiDi Food to drive GMV growth, improve consumer retention and increase merchant ROI; your work will produce measurable uplifts in order frequency, average basket value, and campaign ROI. You will join the Growth & Campaigns team within DiDi Food, where your insights and execution bridge product, marketing, and operations to scale highly targeted campaigns across hundreds of cities and millions of users.

In this role, you'll be...


Analyze campaign performance and customer segments to identify high-impact opportunities, delivering weekly and monthly performance reports that show lift in orders, retention rates, and cost-per-acquisition.
Design and test lifecycle and acquisition campaigns (discounts, bundles, vouchers, push/in-app messaging) end-to-end, managing experiment setup, sample sizing, and statistical validation to achieve predefined KPIs such as incremental orders and ROI.
Partner with product managers aand strategy teams, coupon logic, and real-time allocation mechanisms that ensure campaign scalability and maintain budget efficiency across regions.
Build and maintain dashboards and automated alerts for campaign health, and budget pacing to ensure timely optimization and minimize overspend.
Develop forecasting models and scenario analyses to influence quarterly planning and budget allocation for promotional spend across market tiers.
Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders (marketing, operations, merchant ops) to ensure smooth execution and knowledge transfer of best practices.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


A bachelor’s degree in Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, or equivalent practical experience; a master’s degree or formal training in analytics is a plus.
Demonstrated experience (2+ years) in campaign analytics, growth, or CRM within food delivery, e-commerce, or marketplace environments at scale.
Strong SQL skills with experience building reproducible analyses, A/B test frameworks.
Proficiency in data visualization and dashboard tools and experience operationalizing metrics for cross-functional teams.
Solid understanding of unit economics for food delivery and experience optimizing promotional spend against these levers.
Excellent problem-solving mindset with the ability to translate complex analyses into clear, actionable recommendations and stakeholder-ready presentations.
High ownership, strong communication skills, and experience leading cross-functional execution in fast-moving, multi-market environments without close supervision.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

description:
About the job

About Alpen Labs

Alpen Labs builds infrastructure for financial markets on Bitcoin.

Alpen Finance, currently an internal project name, is our vision for a Bitcoin-native, neobank-like experience: a best-in-class way for users to hold and use BTC and stablecoins while accessing financial services such as credit, earning interest, spending, and so on.

Alpen is the platform that makes this possible directly on Bitcoin, giving users access to modern financial services without requiring them to trust centralized intermediaries. Alpen uses zero-knowledge technology and programmable Layer 2 infrastructure to achieve this.

Our team includes engineers and researchers from organizations such as Blockstream Research, zkSync, Palantir, and Nethermind, as well as contributors to major open-source cryptography and blockchain projects.

The Role

We are hiring a Consumer Marketing Lead to build the marketing function for Alpen Finance from the ground up.

The product is prelaunch, with no established acquisition playbook or proven channel mix. You will develop the marketing approach needed to take it from its initial unveiling through launch and its first meaningful base of customers, then continue to scale what works.

The immediate focus is consumer acquisition: identifying the right prospective customers, translating the product’s positioning into effective marketing, testing channels and campaigns, and building qualified demand before launch.

This is a highly hands-on, commercially oriented role requiring broad marketing fundamentals and strong judgment. You will work closely with leadership, product, and engineering while personally driving both strategy and execution.

What You’ll Do

Build the marketing foundation


Develop a focused consumer marketing strategy for Alpen Finance.
Turn the product vision into clear marketing priorities, campaigns, and operating plans.
Establish the measurement and feedback loops needed to understand what is working.
Create a practical roadmap from prelaunch audience development through launch and postlaunch growth.
Define and advocate for the marketing investment needed to execute the strategy.


Own consumer acquisition


Identify and prioritize the audiences most likely to become valuable early customers.
Find effective ways to reach them in a market where conventional paid advertising may be constrained.
Test channels such as content, community, referrals, partnerships, creators, events, and selective paid media.
Build and operate acquisition programs and prelaunch campaigns.
Turn promising experiments into repeatable acquisition programs.


Prepare and execute the launch


Own the consumer-facing marketing plan for the product’s unveiling and launch.
Coordinate the campaigns, content, channel activity, and customer communications needed for launch.
Build interest before the product is live while setting accurate expectations.
Establish a sustained marketing cadence beyond the initial announcement.


Find and validate product-market fit


Test hypotheses about the customers, use cases, and problems where Alpen Finance can create the most value.
Use customer conversations, acquisition experiments, and product behavior to identify genuine demand and product pull.
Distinguish meaningful PMF signals from attention or low-intent signups.
Bring customer and market evidence into decisions about positioning, product priorities, launch markets, and go-to-market strategy.


Connect acquisition to product usage


Shape the customer journey from awareness and waitlist participation through onboarding, borrowing, card use, and referral.
Work with product and engineering to connect the marketing promise with the product experience.
Understand where customers engage, convert, retain, or drop out.
Evaluate acquisition activity based on customer quality, behavior, and economics, not reach alone.


What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for an entrepreneurial, commercially- minded, hands-on consumer fintech marketer who can build an early-stage marketing operation, acquire a product’s first meaningful customers, and scale what works.

Core Capabilities


3+ years of relevant marketing experience, with meaningful ownership of GTM, customer acquisition, and growth.
Consumer fintech: Experience marketing a consumer fintech, lending, payments, cards, wallet, brokerage, or similarly trust-sensitive financial product.
Zero-to-one consumer marketing: You have helped take a consumer product from prelaunch or very early stage through launch and meaningful adoption, and understand how marketing changes once real customers and acquisition data exist.
Consumer acquisition: You have directly owned acquisition strategy and execution and can identify, test, and scale effective channels.
PMF and commercial judgment: You have owned metrics such as CAC, conversion, activation, retention, referral, or payback and can use them to make decisions about where to invest.
Marketing fundamentals: You can connect customer understanding, positioning, messaging, content, channels, and measurement.
Hands-on execution: You can turn strategy into campaigns, assets, experiments, and operating work.
Customer and market judgment: You can form useful hypotheses from incomplete information, test them, and adjust based on evidence.
Cross-functional ownership: You can move work forward across product, engineering, leadership, and other stakeholders.


We care more about demonstrated work, ownership, and judgment than a particular title or career path.

Valuable Experience


Crypto or Bitcoin products with unconventional customer behavior or acquisition channels.
Community, creator, referral, partnership, content-led, or product-led acquisition.
Marketing products that require customers to understand risk and place meaningful trust in the company.


Why Alpen Labs


Build from zero: Create the consumer marketing function and acquisition approach from the beginning.
Meaningful ownership: Shape how a new Bitcoin financial application reaches its first customers.
Market challenge: Solve acquisition problems for a product that does not fit neatly into conventional consumer-finance categories.
Technical ambition: Work alongside leading engineers and researchers building new infrastructure for Bitcoin-native finance.
Visible impact: Connect Alpen’s technology with useful financial experiences for consumers.

title: Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
About the job

What You'll Own

Campaign Execution

•Build and launch campaigns across email, landing pages, forms, and scheduled social, in HubSpot today and in Odoo and Mailchimp as the stack moves.

•Load and publish content: landing pages, blog posts, gated assets, images, and email templates. Format it, proof it, test it across clients and devices, ship it.

•Build and maintain lists and segments against the ICP and persona definitions supplied by Revenue Marketing.

•Run A/B tests as designed: configure the cells, keep variant tracking clean, and report the result plainly.

•Hold the send calendar across all three businesses so campaigns do not collide or over-mail the same contacts.

Tagging and Attribution

•Apply the campaign taxonomy consistently: campaign codes, UTM parameters, source and medium, and campaign membership on the contact record.

•Keep the chain intact from campaign to content to form to CRM record, so attribution reporting holds up when someone questions it.

•Maintain data hygiene: deduplication, required fields, list hygiene, suppression and unsubscribe handling, and bounce management.

•Test tracking before launch and raise breaks before the campaign sends rather than after the report looks wrong.

Reporting and Optimization

•Produce weekly and monthly performance reporting: sends, engagement, conversion, form fills, and campaign contribution to pipeline.

•Keep dashboards current so leadership does not have to request a refresh to see where things stand.

•Bring observations alongside the numbers. What is working, what is not, and what is worth testing next.

•Recommend and implement improvements to subject lines, send timing, form design, landing page structure, and list targeting based on what the data actually shows.

How We Work

Claude is part of the daily toolkit across the Revenue Marketing function. You will use it to draft and vary campaign copy, QA lists, summarize performance, and automate the repetitive parts of campaign setup. Practical fluency with AI tools is a requirement for this role. If your first instinct on a repetitive task is to find a way to stop doing it by hand, you will do well here.

The team is small, distributed, and asynchronous. Written communication carries most of the weight, and people are trusted to run their own work between check-ins.

What We Are Looking For

Required

•Three or more years in marketing operations, campaign operations, or marketing automation for a B2B company.

•Hands-on ownership of at least one marketing automation platform, such as HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, or Odoo. Real depth in one counts for more than passing exposure to several.

•Evidence that you learn platforms fast. Be ready to describe a stack you picked up on the job and what you shipped in your first month on it.

•Working knowledge of CRM structure: contacts, companies, campaigns, campaign membership, and lifecycle stages.

•Disciplined campaign tagging and UTM practice, and an understanding of the reporting that depends on it.

•Practical fluency with AI tools in daily work. Claude preferred.

•Professional written English and at least four hours of daily overlap with US Eastern time.

•Care with detail. Careless work in this seat breaks quietly and is expensive to find later.

Preferred

•HubSpot experience, which is where the near-term work sits.

•Odoo experience, which is where the stack is going.

•WordPress content publishing.

•Experience supporting more than one business or brand at the same time.

•Having been through a marketing platform migration before, on either side of it.

description:
About the job

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Operations Manager

__


What We Believe In

At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.

Your Role: Own the Challenge

In this role, you will have the opportunity to be working on the sales of High Power Rectifier Systems (HPR) services and upgrades for the Metals and Power Conversion Team within North America. Each day, you will achieve both qualitative and quantitative sales targets to ensure sustainable order growth, revenues, profitability, market share, and customer satisfaction. You will also showcase your expertise by identifying and developing new sales opportunities.

A Service Sales Support Specialist is the backbone of service sales. While working in close collaboration with the responsible sales Manager, he is the creative mind behind the solution being sold, may that be a simple preventive maintenance or a more complex control upgrade for a full system. He is the one proposing and working out the technical solution and the one who will provide the technical expertise and support required for the sale.

He will work with limited supervision with customer accounts and while also being able to directly discuss technical requirements, he will develop solutions with customers to tremendously improve the buy in into and to increase the trust level aimed at developing a long-term relationship.

It also maintains close business relationships with customers, alerting them of new developments or products and assisting in resolving problems.

The work model for the role is:

This role is contributing to the Metals and Power Conversion team with the Automation - Process Industry Division in North America.

You will be mainly accountable for:


Understanding the customer’s requests for support and translating them into an optimal technical and commercial solution.
Preparing the proposal for the services to be offered to customers by doing basic engineering and by working with all supporting functions including engineering, supply chain, HSE, and contract management departments and even main suppliers.
Communicating and negotiating in collaboration with the sales manager responsible with the customers on commercial aspects of the proposal such as payments, warranty, prices, and general terms and conditions, in line with ABB’s offering and strategy.
Managing administrative procedures in sales processes and project management activities, when needed.
Coordinating activities with customer and project management.


Our team dynamics

You will join a highly skilled, fast-moving, proactive team, where you will be able to thrive. A team driven by curiosity and that strives to find the best technical and commercial solution for our customers. A team that is not afraid of taking on challenges and to innovate. A team with a strong “can do” attitude that always acts with integrity and follows the health and safety guidelines.


Qualifications For The Role


Ability to demonstrate your experience in basic electrical engineering. You have worked at least 5 years in an industrial environment with 3+ years of experience in and working knowledge of electrical engineering applied to Power Converters and Electrical Distribution.
Experience with Variable Frequency Drives and Power Converters will be an advantage.
Experience and working knowledge with High Power Rectifier systems will be a strong asset.
You are passionate about your work and interested in finding optimal solutions. You are captivated by actively listening to customers and understanding their problems and you take it as a personal challenge to find the best solution by collaborating with and coordinating engineering, supply chain, contract manager, and logistic resources to create an optimal solution.
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related
You are at ease communicating in English 
Ability to travel if required in the United States and Canada



Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:


Performance Bonus
Saving fund
Paid parental leave
Life insurance
Retirement plan
Health and dental insurance
Wellbeing program
Flex days
Employee Assistance Program (PAE)
Access to development platforms: Spark, Harvard Manager Mentor and English Learning EF English Live School (EF)



What's In It For You

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the world.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

About the job

Your Team Responsibilities

We are currently seeking an experienced Analytics Client Service Specialist to join our Client Coverage organization in Monterrey.

The MSCI Global Client Service team is composed of experienced financial professionals that provide first tier support for our clients around the world. Team members are responsible for responding to a wide variety of methodology, usage, interpretational, and technical questions on both analytical and benchmark products. Client contact is primarily via telephone and email, but occasional travel may be required for on-site presentations or trainings. Client Service Specialists work closely with account managers and consultants to develop and maintain client relationships.

Your Key Responsibilities


Answer detailed client inquiries about MSCI products and methodology 
Participate in developing client relationships through proactive follow up on issues raised by clients 
Analyze market performance and data for our clients on a reactive and a pro-active basis 
Maintain relationships by ensuring relevant product and model information is shared with clients 
Provide client feedback to the Coverage, Product Management, Research and Data groups 
Keep up with current events and trends in the marketplace

Your skills and experience that will help you excel


Strong analytic, quantitative, and problem-solving skills
Demonstrated understanding of financial topics which should include some of the following: Modern Portfolio Theory, Equity and Portfolio Construction, Optimization, Cap Asset Pricing models, Multi Factor Risk Models, Market Risk, Credit Risk and VAR
Deep understanding of international financial institutions and global financial markets
Proactive and highly motivated, track record of challenging self and others to anticipate future trends and creatively capitalize on opportunities
Ability to develop value-added contributions to both internal and external clients
Excellent communication skills, ability to articulate complicated concepts or methodologies verbally and in writing to senior management and clients
Strong organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple projects under tight, short-term deadlines
Dynamic, track record of excelling in an environment of ambiguity by quickly adapting behavior and work methods to adjust to multiple demands and shifting priorities
Teamwork, ability to work efficiently with diverse cultures on a global team and knowing when to involve appropriate colleagues in projects regardless of function or location

 5-7 years’ experience in Financial Services

 MFE, MBA, Masters Degree and/or CFA , or equivalent highly desired

Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.

description:
About the job

Bask is the best telehealth platform on the market. Our mission is to empower entrepreneurs and businesses to launch a DTC telemedicine company quickly and easily, abstracting away the complexities of the industry into an easy-to-use platform. With hundreds of features to meet the unique needs of telehealth, we put all the tools in our customers hands for success. We are a rapidly growing startup, and we work with care and intention to create a high-performance company with the following in mind:

Speed Wins. Make decisions, move quickly, and know that if things go wrong, it's okay for you and the company.
Intuition, Then Data. We're a data-driven company. We start with our instincts and then use data to validate our decisions and improve
Miles, Not Inches. Thinking small is a self-fulfilling prophecy. Favor bold ideas over incremental changes
Customer-Obsession. We are obsessed with helping all our customers launch multi-billion-dollar companies with ease. We accomplish this by knowing our customers incredibly well and finding ways to make their businesses better.
Ownership & Accountability, together. We embody a culture of extreme ownership, accountability, and teamwork. We count on every team member to take responsibility for their work, embrace a proactive mindset to overcome challenges, and work together to achieve our collective success


A look into the day to day:

Building logic based questionnaires (asynchronous visits) through the Bask software (if you have experience with building logic based workflows, you'll be great at this!)
Helping customers launch and upsell medications from start to to finish
Triaging bask software and order related questions and issues that come up for any of your accounts, any time of the day


We're Looking For

A self-starter who is passionate about enhancing the customer experience; you take pride in demonstrating the value of the products and services to your customers. You think outside of the box, excel at creative problem-solving, and are comfortable taking on projects that you have potentially never done before! You are a people-person - empathetic, self-aware, low ego, and extremely positive - and are comfortable working in a small collaborative team where you'll wear many hats. You are passionate and proficient in written and spoken communications.



Customer Success at Bask Health is AI-first and customer-obsessed. Work starts in an LLM to clarify intent and context, moves into research and execution, is validated with real patients and partners, and is continuously refined as we learn. AI and self-serve research are default parts of the workflow, not side experiments.

We are looking for Customer Success people who take full ownership of their accounts, treat AI as a real collaborator, and care deeply about the patient and provider experience.

What You'll Do

Work AI-first: Use LLMs as your starting point to draft communications, structure problems, and think through customer needs. Apply your own judgment to refine the output and make it human.
Validate with real customers and iterate: Test your approaches with real patients, providers, and partners. Use what you learn to improve how we serve them — before issues become patterns.
Make automation legible and trustworthy: Help customers understand what Bask's platform is doing on their behalf. Communicate clearly and proactively to build trust while keeping their experience simple.

Share AI-native workflows: Document prompts, processes, and workflows that work. Share them across the Customer Success team so we raise the bar together.


In this job, you will:

Build strong relationships with Bask's customers and own the full customer lifecycle, including onboarding, value realization, engagement strategies, expansion, and renewals
Partner with customer stakeholders to develop custom engagement initiatives that drive user adoption and support the unique needs of their patients
Manage all current customer data
Analyze customer engagement metrics and use them to communicate value, trends, and opportunities with key stakeholders
Deliver program demos, provide insightful technical answers, and recommend creative ways to get the most out of the Bask platform
Finding comfort in working in a fast-paced startup environment
Believing no task is too small and no task is too tall
Work Weekends

Comfortable collaborating with different teams (product, sales, marketing, etc.)

About the job

Ser parte de TecSalud significa colaborar en una comunidad que transforma la salud con innovación, educación de excelencia e investigación de vanguardia. Aquí cada enfermera(o), médicos, radiólogos y personal de apoyo, tiene la oportunidad de hacer lo que mejor sabe, desarrollarse e impactar positivamente a la sociedad.

¡Esta oportunidad es para ti!

Únete a TecSalud y juntos transformemos la calidad de vida de las personas.


¿Qué harás? 


Siendo Coordinador de Atención y Soporte al Usuario el reto principal es coordinar la operación integral de los canales de Atención a Usuarios, asegurando la resolución oportuna de las solicitudes de usuarios internos y externos, la correcta ejecución de los procesos administrativos y el cumplimiento de los niveles de servicio establecidos, mediante la administración del equipo, el análisis de indicadores, la estandarización de procesos y la implementación de estrategias de mejora continua, con el propósito de fortalecer la experiencia del usuario, incrementar la eficiencia operativa y contribuir al cumplimiento de los objetivos institucionales.


¿Cómo lo harás? 


Tus Principales Retos Serán:


Asegurar la correcta operación de los canales de Atención a Usuarios, garantizando el cumplimiento de los niveles de servicio, calidad y experiencia establecidos por la institución. 
Garantizar la resolución oportuna de las solicitudes recibidas por los diferentes canales de atención, asegurando su gestión de inicio a fin, el seguimiento con las áreas responsables y el cierre oportuno de cada requerimiento. 
Analizar los indicadores operativos y administrativos, generando información para la toma de decisiones e implementando planes de acción que aseguren el cumplimiento de los objetivos del servicio. 
Diseñar e implementar estrategias que fortalezcan la resolución en el primer contacto, disminuyan la dependencia de procesos manuales y mejoren la eficiencia operativa, promoviendo una cultura de mejora continua
Coordinar proyectos de mejora, automatización e inteligencia artificial, colaborando con las áreas involucradas para fortalecer el modelo de atención y optimizar los procesos operativos. 
Fortalecer la comunicación y coordinación con las áreas clínicas, operativas y administrativas, estableciendo mecanismos de seguimiento, acuerdos de servicio y estrategias que favorezcan la resolución oportuna de las solicitudes
Promover la estandarización, documentación y cumplimiento de los procesos, asegurando la sostenibilidad de la operación y facilitando la implementación de nuevos modelos de trabajo
¿Qué buscamos? 


Si tienes formación en Licenciatura concluida en Administración, Comunicación, Ingenieria en Sistemas y/o afín, has tenido la experiencia de trabajar en gestión de operaciones de atención y soporte al usuario, administración de procesos administrativos, gestión de indicadores operativos y administrativos (nivel de servicio, ASA, tasa de abandono, Productividad, FCR, SLA, entre otros), administración y desarrollo de equipos de trabajo, elaboración y análisis de reportes para la toma de decisiones, gestión de la experiencia del usuario y modelos de atención y entre tus habilidades se encuentran dominio de herramientas Office 365, Excel intermedio - avanzado, administración funcional de plataformas de atención (Cisco, ServiceNow o equivalentes), liderazgo de equipos, orientación a resultados, planeación y organización, comunicación efectiva. ¡Te estamos buscando, postúlate ya!

SIG competencies

We are looking for people who are willing to consistently achieve results, even under tough circumstances, employees who create a climate where everyone is motivated to do their best to help the organization achieve its objectives. If you actively seek new ways to grow and be challenged, if you develop people to meet both their career goals and the organization's goals, SIG is the place for you. To deliver better for our customers, our future colleagues build strong customer relationships and deliver customer-centric solutions. Finally, we are looking for colleagues who build partnerships and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. Are you someone who applies knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization's goals? Are you someone who can create new and better ways for the organization to be successful? If the answer is 'yes', come and join us.

Our promise

SIG is the place for you to build something incredible. We offer competitive compensation and an opportunity to partially work from home. If you join us, you will be part of a globally successful international company, which is leading its industry in sustainability, technology, and more. We think of ourselves as the career launchpad - a place to develop yourself fast with real work, real experience, real opportunities to build skills. You will be part of a highly motivated and dynamic team, you will have personal development opportunities, trainings and coaching opportunities from senior team members. If you show skill and willingness to learn, we'll back you all the way.

About SIG

SIG is a leading provider of packaging systems and solutions for better. We work in partnership with our customers to bring food products to consumers around the world in a safe, sustainable, and affordable way. We are the only packaging system supplier covering carton, pouch, and bag-in-box. Our versatile technology and product innovation capacity enable us to deliver better for customers, for consumers, and for the world. Sustainability guides us, technology empowers us, but it's the passion and drive of our people that truly enable us to deliver better. Founded in 1853, SIG is headquartered in Neuhausen, Switzerland, and listed at the SIX Swiss Exchange.

About the job

En ABB, ayudamos a las industrias a funcionar de forma más eficiente y limpia, y cada una de las personas que trabajan aquí lo hace posible. Estarás capacitado para liderar, apoyado para crecer y orgulloso del impacto que creamos juntos. Únete a nosotros y ayuda a que funcione lo que hace funcionar el mundo.

Este Puesto Reporta a

Operations Manager

__

What We Believe In

At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.

Your Role: Own the Challenge

In this role, you will have the opportunity to be working on the sales of High Power Rectifier Systems (HPR) services and upgrades for the Metals and Power Conversion Team within North America. Each day, you will achieve both qualitative and quantitative sales targets to ensure sustainable order growth, revenues, profitability, market share, and customer satisfaction. You will also showcase your expertise by identifying and developing new sales opportunities.

A Service Sales Support Specialist is the backbone of service sales. While working in close collaboration with the responsible sales Manager, he is the creative mind behind the solution being sold, may that be a simple preventive maintenance or a more complex control upgrade for a full system. He is the one proposing and working out the technical solution and the one who will provide the technical expertise and support required for the sale.

He will work with limited supervision with customer accounts and while also being able to directly discuss technical requirements, he will develop solutions with customers to tremendously improve the buy in into and to increase the trust level aimed at developing a long-term relationship.

It also maintains close business relationships with customers, alerting them of new developments or products and assisting in resolving problems.

The Work Model For The Role Is

This role is contributing to the Metals and Power Conversion team with the Automation - Process Industry Division in North America.

You Will Be Mainly Accountable For


Understanding the customer’s requests for support and translating them into an optimal technical and commercial solution.
Preparing the proposal for the services to be offered to customers by doing basic engineering and by working with all supporting functions including engineering, supply chain, HSE, and contract management departments and even main suppliers.

Managing administrative procedures in sales processes and project management activities, when needed.
Coordinating activities with customer and project management.


Our team dynamics

You will join a highly skilled, fast-moving, proactive team, where you will be able to thrive. A team driven by curiosity and that strives to find the best technical and commercial solution for our customers. A team that is not afraid of taking on challenges and to innovate. A team with a strong “can do” attitude that always acts with integrity and follows the health and safety guidelines.

Qualifications For The Role


Ability to demonstrate your experience in basic electrical engineering. You have worked at least 5 years in an industrial environment with 3+ years of experience in and working knowledge of electrical engineering applied to Power Converters and Electrical Distribution.
Experience with Variable Frequency Drives and Power Converters will be an advantage.
Experience and working knowledge with High Power Rectifier systems will be a strong asset.

title: Customer Support Specialist — B2B Payments
skills: Support business customers: Handle inquiries in English and Spanish through chat, email, and ticketing systems, covering business onboarding and KYB documentation, incoming funds, cross-border payments, currency conversion, transaction status, and stablecoin transfers.
Own cases through resolution: Proactively update customers, prioritize issues based on urgency and financial or business impact, and coordinate timely escalation and follow-up.

Investigate payment and technical issues: Gather transaction IDs, payment confirmations, error messages, and reproduction steps. Use available system records to conduct initial troubleshooting and provide clear, complete escalation details to Operations, Treasury, Compliance, or Engineering.

Use AI and improve workflows: Use company-approved AI tools for knowledge retrieval, case summaries, response drafting, and issue analysis. Verify outputs, take responsibility for customer-facing responses, and identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks.
Improve documentation and customer experience: Maintain help articles, FAQs, and internal guides. Identify recurring issues and work with Product and Operations to address their underlying causes.

Maintain service quality: Coordinate effectively across teams in Latin America, the United States, and Asia, ensuring clear handoffs. Help improve response times, resolution times, accuracy, and customer satisfaction while protecting customer information.
2–5 years of experience in customer support, customer operations, or payment operations, preferably within fintech, payments, or financial services.
Fluent written and spoken English and Spanish, with the ability to independently handle customer conversations, explain complex issues, and collaborate across regions.
Experience managing complex cases, communicating calmly under pressure, and driving resolution even when information is incomplete.
An understanding of payment processes and customer verification requirements, including the ability to track transaction status, verify information, and identify appropriate escalation paths.
Practical experience using AI tools to improve research, problem-solving, customer communication, or daily workflows, with the judgment to verify their outputs.
Familiarity with Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk, or similar customer support platforms, including case documentation, prioritization, and follow-up.
Strong technical aptitude and the ability to learn new products, interpret system messages, and translate customer issues into actionable troubleshooting information.
A proactive, accountable approach and the ability to balance speed, accuracy, and customer experience in a fast-moving environment.
Experience supporting B2B customers, cross-border payments, local payment networks such as SPEI, or stablecoin services.
Familiarity with wallet addresses, blockchain networks, transaction hashes, and blockchain explorers.
Hands-on experience configuring support chatbots, maintaining knowledge bases, or building workflows with tools such as n8n, Make, or Zapier.
The ability to interpret basic API errors or use Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, Metabase, or similar tools to investigate support and transaction issues.
Mandarin proficiency to support collaboration with teams in Asia.
description:
About the job

Customer Support Specialist — B2B Payments




Location: Mexico — Remote or hybrid (Mexico City, Guadalajara, or Monterrey)




Employment Type: Full-time




Languages: Fluent English and Spanish required; Mandarin is a plus




About VelaFi

VelaFi is a B2B cross-border payments and stablecoin financial infrastructure company connecting Latin America, the United States, and Asia. We combine local payment networks, global payment infrastructure, and blockchain technology to help businesses collect, move, convert, and settle funds more efficiently.

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Customer Support Specialist to support our business customers throughout their experience with VelaFi. You will help resolve onboarding, payment, and platform-related issues, coordinate with internal teams, and keep customers informed from initial inquiry through resolution.

The ideal candidate combines strong customer service skills with payment knowledge, technical curiosity, and practical experience using AI tools to improve productivity. You will also help turn recurring customer issues into improvements to our knowledge base, workflows, and products.

Experience supporting B2B customers, cross-border payments, local payment networks such as SPEI, or stablecoin services.

title: Event Marketing Manager | B2B & Corporate Events
description:
About the job

For our client, an international technology company that is strengthening its commercial and marketing presence in Mexico and LATAM, we are looking for Event Marketing Manager | B2B Tech Events in Mexico.




We are looking for a proactive, hands-on and highly organized Event Marketing Manager who can take ownership of event activities in Mexico, from identifying the right opportunities and managing local vendors to lead capture, CRM follow-up and post-event performance analysis.

This is not a purely operational event-planning role.




The main goal of this role is to make events a measurable commercial channel by supporting brand awareness, generating qualified leads, contributing to SQL and pipeline creation, and connecting event participation with clear business outcomes.

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR IN OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE

· We are looking for a proactive, responsible, and highly organized professional who can take ownership of event execution in Mexico and manage multiple details, vendors, deadlines, and internal stakeholders at the same time.

· The ideal candidate should have solid experience organizing corporate, B2B marketing events and should understand that events are not only about logistis, but also about brand visibility, lead generation, CRM follow-up, and business impact.

 

EXPERIENCE IN THE FOLLOWING SECTORS WOULD BE HIGHLY VALUABLE:

B2B technology; SaaS; FinTech / PayTech; banking technology; telecom; CPaaS; cloud communications; contact center technology; enterprise software; digital B2B services; corporate event agencies serving technology or business clients. 

 

1. Experience in event management, event marketing, field marketing, corporate events, B2B events. 

2. Previous experience organizing business-focused events such as conferences, trade shows, expos, sponsored events, business lunches, executive dinners, roundtables, or partner events. 

3. Strong experience coordinating local vendors, including venues, production teams, booth builders, printing suppliers, merchandise providers, catering providers, and logistics partners. 

4. Ability to manage event timelines, budgets, materials, approvals, deadlines, and several event-related workstreams simultaneously. 

5. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through. 

6. Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills. 

7. Ability to work independently, anticipate risks, and proactively follow up on open tasks. 

8. Fluent Spanish for local coordination with vendors, venues, and partners in Mexico + Strong business English for communication with the direct manager and international teams. 

9. Based in Mexico, ideally in Mexico City or nearby. 

10. Availability to travel when required for events.

 

MAIN JOB FUNCTIONS

1. Develop and regularly update the annual event calendar for Mexico and LATAM prioritizing activities based on ICP fit, brand relevance, and commercial potential. 

2. Identify and evaluate relevant conferences, summits, trade shows, business events, executive dinners, roundtables, sponsorships, and co-hosted event opportunities. 

3. Coordinate the company’s participation in events from end to end, including planning, budgeting, logistics, vendor management, booth or brand zone preparation, materials, merchandise, and onsite execution. 

4. Manage local vendors and partners in Mexico, including booth builders, production teams, venues, catering providers, printing suppliers, merchandising providers, logistics partners, and event agencies. 

5. Work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Content, PR, and regional teams to ensure that each event is aligned with commercial priorities, target accounts, product messaging, and marketing goals. 

6. Support lead generation during events by helping the Sales team collect, organize, and qualify leads through badge scanning, forms, meetings, demos, networking activities, and other lead capture methods. 

7. Ensure proper synchronization of event leads with the company’s CRM, such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar systems, including accurate tagging, data quality, lead ownership, and follow-up visibility. 

8. Coordinate post-event follow-up activities together with Sales, Content, and Product Marketing teams, including email campaigns, social media coverage, PR materials, presentations, and nurture flows. 

9. Support the organization of smaller high-value event formats, such as executive dinners, business lunches, partner events, roundtables, and co-branded activities. 

10. Track event performance and prepare post-event reports, analyzing KPIs such as MQLs, SQLs, CPL, conversion rate, meetings generated, pipeline contribution, ARR potential, branded traffic, media mentions, and overall ROI. 

 

Why Join This Team?

1. This is a great opportunity to join an international B2B technology company expanding in Mexico and LATAM, with a highly attractive compensation package, a mostly remote work format, and the opportunity to travel for key events and conferences.

2. You will take real ownership of event marketing activities in Mexico, working on high-impact initiatives that go beyond logistics and directly support brand visibility, qualified lead generation, pipeline contribution, and business growth.

3. The role offers strong exposure to cloud communications, CPaaS, contact center solutions, and customer engagement technologies, while collaborating with international Marketing, Sales, Product Marketing, Content, and regional teams.

4. You will join a supportive, collaborative, and non-toxic environment where responsibility, initiative, learning, and ownership are valued. You will also receive guidance from an experienced manager and regional event team, while having the freedom to bring ideas, improve processes, test new event formats, and help build a stronger event marketing function in Mexico.

 

Three Keys to Success in This Position

 

 Ownership, responsibility, and strong execution discipline

 Strong local execution and vendor management in Mexico

 Business-oriented event marketing mindset

 

If you are proactive, highly organized, and excited about building impactful B2B event marketing activities in Mexico, we would be very happy to meet you. Please send your CV to this email cv@tk-recruitment.com we would love to learn more about you.

Brother es una compañía global de tecnología con más de 115 años de historia, reconocida por desarrollar soluciones que simplifican y enriquecen la forma en que las personas viven, trabajan y crean.




Nuestro portafolio incluye soluciones de impresión para hogar, oficina y empresas, soluciones de etiquetado e identificación, costura y manualidades, así como soluciones industriales.

Brother México inició operaciones en 1992 y forma parte de Brother International Corporation, subsidiaria de Brother Industries, Ltd., compañía global con sede en Nagoya, Japón y presencia en más de 30 países.




¿Por qué trabajar en Brother?

En Brother México creemos que las personas son fundamentales para nuestro éxito. Promovemos un ambiente inclusivo, colaborativo y flexible, donde cada persona puede contribuir, desarrollarse y generar impacto.




Nuestra cultura se guía por cuatro impulsores que definen cómo trabajamos y tomamos decisiones:

Responsabilidad | Autenticidad | Audacia | Excelencia

Bajo nuestra promesa “At your side”, buscamos estar cerca de nuestros clientes, colaboradores y comunidades, creando soluciones y experiencias que generen valor sostenible.




Sobre la posición

Buscamos un/a Product Marketing Analyst para contribuir al desarrollo de nuestra categoría de soluciones de impresión para hogar, oficina y empresas, con un enfoque particular en el canal de mayoreo y distribución.




Es una posición que combina Product Marketing, análisis comercial, estrategia de producto y trabajo cercano con Ventas, con exposición a clientes, distribuidores y equipos internacionales.




Tu principal objetivo




Impulsar el desarrollo de la categoría de impresión en México mediante estrategias de producto y marketing que contribuyan al crecimiento de Sell In y Sell Out, rentabilidad, participación de mercado, penetración del portafolio y desarrollo de canales.

Buscamos a una persona capaz de analizar el negocio de punta a punta —producto, precio, inventario, competencia, canales y resultados— y convertir esos insights en acciones comerciales concretas.




¿Qué harás?

📊 Product & Business Analysis

Analizar el desempeño de la categoría considerando Sell In, Sell Out, inventario, forecast, crecimiento y mix de producto, identificando oportunidades y riesgos.
Analizar el posicionamiento de los productos frente a la competencia y dentro de los diferentes canales.
Realizar análisis de precios, TCO (Total Cost of Ownership), Market Share y tendencias de mercado.
Analizar el desempeño de productos, iniciativas comerciales y acciones de marketing, proponiendo planes de mejora.
Generar análisis de GP, rentabilidad y ROI por producto, iniciativa y canal.
Identificar oportunidades para incrementar participación de mercado, rentabilidad y penetración del portafolio.




🚀 Product & Go-to-Market Strategy

Participar en el desarrollo de estrategias de lanzamiento, posicionamiento y crecimiento de productos.
Desarrollar propuestas de valor y argumentos comerciales para las diferentes soluciones de impresión.
Diseñar acciones para impulsar el crecimiento de productos y consumibles.
Participar en la definición de estrategias de producto, precio, promoción y canal.
Desarrollar briefs y materiales de apoyo para Ventas y puntos de venta.

🤝 Sales & Channel Partnership

Trabajar estrechamente con Ventas para definir y ejecutar estrategias de Sell In y Sell Out.
Revisar periódicamente el forecast con el equipo comercial.
Brindar soporte de producto y marketing a los equipos de Ventas.
Realizar visitas de campo y mantener contacto activo con clientes y distribuidores para identificar oportunidades y obtener insights del mercado.
Participar en actividades y eventos orientados al desarrollo de clientes y canales.
Preparar presentaciones de producto y estrategias comerciales para clientes internos y externos.
Identificar y canalizar requerimientos o problemáticas técnicas reportadas por clientes hacia las áreas correspondientes.




📣 Marketing & Demand Generation

Definir necesidades y prioridades de comunicación de la categoría.
Trabajar en conjunto con el equipo de Marketing Digital para desarrollar estrategias de comunicación y generación de demanda.
Colaborar en iniciativas relacionadas con website, e-commerce, redes sociales y contenido digital, mientras la ejecución permanece a cargo de los equipos especializados.
Asegurar que la información y contenido de producto sean correctos, consistentes y relevantes en los diferentes canales.

🌎 Global Collaboration & Product Management

Coordinar información y especificaciones técnicas relacionadas con nuevos productos.

💰 Pricing, Budget & Profitability

Administrar y dar seguimiento al presupuesto de marketing de la categoría.
Apoyar la preparación anual de Budget, Net Sales y GP.
Monitorear el impacto financiero de las iniciativas de producto y marketing.
Contribuir a decisiones comerciales buscando un balance entre crecimiento, competitividad y rentabilidad.




¿Qué buscamos?

Licenciatura concluida en Marketing, Administración, Negocios, Ingeniería Comercial o áreas afines.
Experiencia en Product Marketing, Category Management, Trade Marketing, Marketing Comercial, Business Analysis o posiciones relacionadas.

About Corsa

At Corsa, we connect exceptional professionals across Latin America with meaningful remote opportunities at growing U.S. companies. We believe great talent should have access to great opportunities, regardless of where they live.

About Our Client

Our client is an established New York public relations agency with more than 30 years in business, serving technology and digital media companies worldwide.

The agency helps clients earn relevant coverage across digital and print publications, podcasts, television, magazines, and newsletters.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Media Strategist who knows how to find the right journalist—not simply build a longer contact list.

You’ll research reporters and outlets, understand their coverage and audiences, identify relevant story opportunities, and turn that research into thoughtful pitches and targeted outreach.

Reporting to the Executive Director, you’ll support multiple client accounts through accurate research, strong writing, and organized follow-through.

This is a public relations and media-relations role—not social media management or influencer marketing.

What You’ll Do
Research journalists, publications, podcasts, newsletters, and other relevant media.
Build and maintain accurate media lists based on journalist beats, recent coverage, and audience relevance.
Expand the agency’s existing database and identify new press opportunities.
Write tailored pitches and story ideas.
Conduct targeted outreach and follow-up.
Maintain organized research and outreach records and communicate progress clearly.
Support media briefings and advise on press opportunities where your experience allows.

Approximately 3–4 years of relevant public relations or media-relations experience, agency-side or in-house.
Strong research skills and sound judgment about which journalists and outlets fit a story.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Experience writing clear, credible, audience-specific pitches.
Hands-on familiarity with media-research platforms such as Cision and Muck Rack.
Strong attention to detail, organization, and reliable remote communication.
Comfort collaborating across multiple client accounts.
Preferred Experience
Supporting technology or digital media clients.
Coordinating media briefings or advising executives on press opportunities.
Successful targeted outreach or earned coverage.
Using AI meeting-assistant tools to support notes and organization.

A strong research and writing background matters more than a particular track record of media placements.

Compensation and Benefits

Approximately $2,080–$2,775 USD per month, depending on experience, based on 40 paid hours per week. Payments are made every two weeks.

PTO, sick leave, holidays, and discretionary spot bonuses are offered. Final workdays, paid hours, and benefit details will be agreed with the client.

description:
About the job

About Lambdac




Lambdac is a scientific consulting company providing expert guidance and support across scientific and technical fields. We work with clients to solve complex problems, optimise processes and support data-driven decision-making, collaborating with specialists and leaders across disciplines on long-term client relationships.




The role




The Installations and Service Engineer is responsible for installing, commissioning and maintaining laboratory and diagnostic instruments at client sites across Mexico and Latin America.

You will be Lambdac’s technical presence in the field: the person clients see when new equipment arrives, and the person they contact when an instrument requires technical attention.

The role will focus primarily on Labsystems Diagnostics equipment and instrumentation, including systems used in newborn screening, clinical diagnostics and laboratory automation.

Key responsibilities include:

Installation and commissioning of new instruments.
Verification of site requirements prior to installation.
Initial configuration and functional testing.
Preventive and corrective maintenance.
Diagnosis and repair of technical faults, both on site and remotely.
Follow-up of technical issues through resolution.
Training client personnel on correct equipment use and routine care.
Preparation of service reports, installation records, maintenance records and calibration documentation.
Review and interpretation of technical manuals and procedures.
Communication with international manufacturers’ technical teams.
Identification and follow-up of spare parts, tools and components required for service activities.
Clear documentation of every technical intervention.

The position requires frequent work at client sites and willingness to travel within Mexico and, when required, to other countries in Latin America.




What we are looking for




Degree in Biomedical, Electronic, Mechanical, Mechatronic Engineering or a related technical field.
Hands-on experience installing or servicing laboratory, diagnostic or medical equipment.
Ability to perform methodical fault diagnosis.
Knowledge of instrumentation, electrical systems, electronics and electromechanical systems.
Ability to work with instrument software and automated systems.
Ability to interpret manuals, procedures and technical documentation.
Discipline to document clearly what was performed and what was found during each service intervention.
Good written and spoken English, sufficient to follow technical manuals and work directly with international manufacturers.
Ability to explain technical matters clearly to non-technical users.
Willingness to travel within Mexico and Latin America, sometimes at short notice.
Valid driving licence.
Ability to work independently in the field.




Experience with in vitro diagnostic equipment, laboratory instrumentation, automated systems, chromatography, mass spectrometry, sample-processing systems, instrument software, barcode readers and traceability systems will be particularly valued.

Familiarity with regulatory documentation or quality management systems within healthcare will be considered a plus.
