title: Account Executive - Distribution Solutions
description:
About the job




Sobre CUBBO







Somos CUBBO, una empresa respaldada por venture capital que construye la infraestructura del ecommerce — combinando tecnología y logística para que las marcas escalen el comercio moderno.




Apoyamos a las marcas conectando todo su proceso de pedidos —desde la compra hasta la entrega— a través de tecnología y operaciones.




Nuestra plataforma atiende a cientos de marcas y procesa +1M de pedidos mensuales, entregando con velocidad y consistencia.




Trabajamos desde la Ciudad de México, donde nuestro equipo construye herramientas y capacidades logísticas para el comercio moderno.







Nuestra Visión







Empoderar a las marcas para que ganen libertad, convirtiéndonos en la plataforma presente en cada transacción del comercio moderno.







No estamos aquí solo para competir; estamos aquí para dominar y redefinir el futuro del comercio moderno. Si eres un jugador AAA, CUBBO te ofrece una plataforma sin igual para ser parte de esta transformación.







Nuestra Misión







Ayudamos al comercio moderno a reducir fricción y entregar mejores experiencias de compra. Nuestra plataforma conecta todo el proceso de pedidos —desde la compra hasta la entrega— a través de tecnología, operaciones y logística.







Ubicación







Ciudad de México (Headquarters)




Modelo híbrido: 4 días presencial, 1 día remoto




Sí, no somos 100% remotos.







El Rol




Como Account Executive para Distribution Solutions, no serás simplemente un vendedor; serás el arquitecto que diseña cómo las marcas más importantes de México y el mundo escalan sus operaciones. Tu misión es transformar la complejidad logística en una ventaja competitiva, posicionando a Cubbo como la columna vertebral tecnológica y operativa de las marcas de consumo moderno.




Serás el dueño del ciclo de ventas de principio a fin, identificando oportunidades estratégicas donde nuestras soluciones de distribución e infraestructura puedan desbloquear un crecimiento sin precedentes para nuestros clientes. Tu impacto se medirá en la eficiencia de miles de pedidos y en la consolidación de Cubbo como el líder indiscutible del ecosistema e-commerce en la región.




Buscamos a un closer nato, alguien que se sienta cómodo navegando conversaciones complejas y que comparta nuestra obsesión por redefinir el comercio moderno. Si te apasiona la tecnología, la logística y ganar en un entorno de hiper-crecimiento, este es tu lugar.







Responsabilidades Clave




**Estrategia de Ventas y Prospección**

• Identificar y calificar clientes potenciales de alto valor (marcas regionales y globales) que requieran infraestructura avanzada de distribución.

• Construir y gestionar un pipeline robusto de oportunidades para asegurar el cumplimiento de metas mensuales y trimestrales.

• Desarrollar estrategias de prospección personalizadas que resalten la propuesta de valor única de Cubbo en tecnología y logística.




**Consultoría y Cierre de Negocios**

• Liderar presentaciones y demostraciones técnicas, articulando cómo nuestra infraestructura resuelve problemas críticos de la cadena de suministro.

• Negociar términos comerciales complejos y cerrar acuerdos multianuales que aseguren el crecimiento a largo plazo de la compañía.

• Colaborar con los equipos de Operaciones y Producto para asegurar que las soluciones propuestas sean viables y escalables.




**Gestión de Relaciones y Mercado**

• Actuar como un asesor estratégico para los tomadores de decisiones (C-level), entendiendo profundamente sus necesidades de negocio.

• Analizar tendencias de mercado y competencia para adaptar nuestro discurso de ventas y mantener nuestra ventaja competitiva.

• Mantener una higiene rigurosa del CRM para proporcionar visibilidad precisa sobre el pronóstico de ventas y el comportamiento del mercado.







Habilidades y Competencias




• Mentalidad de Ownership: dueño de sus números y de la experiencia del cliente.

• Resiliencia y persistencia para navegar ciclos de venta largos y entornos startup de alta velocidad.

• Habilidades de comunicación excepcionales y capacidad de persuasión a nivel directivo.

• Orientación absoluta a resultados (Quota Crusher).







Hard Skills




• Experiencia demostrable en ventas B2B de ciclo complejo (Logística, SaaS, o Supply Chain).

• Dominio de metodologías de venta consultiva.

• Manejo avanzado de herramientas CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot o similares) para la gestión de pipeline.

• Capacidad de análisis financiero para construir Business Cases y calcular el ROI para clientes potenciales.

• Inglés profesional fluido (capacidad para negociar con marcas internacionales).







Deseable




• Red de contactos establecida en el sector de Retail o E-commerce en México.

• Experiencia previa en startups de logística, tecnología de rápido crecimiento o retail.

• Conocimiento profundo del ecosistema de e-commerce (marketplaces, plataformas de última milla, etc.).

• Pasión por los retos técnicos y la innovación en procesos comerciales.







Nuestros Valores







Customer First: En CUBBO, el cliente es nuestra estrella norte. Operamos bajo el principio de que la mejor decisión para nuestros clientes es la mejor decisión para nosotros.







Confianza: Confías en tus compañeros Cubbeños, reconociendo que el trabajo en equipo es esencial para nuestro éxito colectivo.







Empoderamiento: En CUBBO, esperar instrucciones no es opción. Eres un catalizador que empodera a otros a tomar la iniciativa y tomar decisiones de impacto.







Growth Mindset: Siempre estás haciendo preguntas, con hambre de mejorar. Si no te da pena lo que hacías hace seis meses, no estás creciendo lo suficientemente rápido.







Velocidad: Las ideas solas no ganan mercados; la ejecución rápida y efectiva sí. Actuamos rápido, nos adaptamos y convertimos planes en resultados.







Candor: La transparencia y el feedback constructivo son la base de nuestra cultura. Valoramos la honestidad orientada al crecimiento personal y profesional.







¿Por qué unirte a CUBBO?







Sé parte de una revolución







Únete a nosotros para establecer estándares disruptivos en la industria y cambiar la cara del ecommerce en Latinoamérica. Estamos revolucionando la región entera a través de la innovación.







Trabaja con los mejores







Acelera tu crecimiento profesional exponencialmente en CUBBO. Un año aquí equivale a una década de experiencia en otro lugar. Si eres un high-performer que busca un equipo de campeones, tu búsqueda termina aquí.







Construido para durar, construido para ganar







No solo sobrevivimos; estamos creciendo. Nuestra salud financiera nos permite enfocarnos en lo que realmente importa: ganar el mercado y asegurar una experiencia al cliente sin igual.




Salario




• MXN 55000 bruto mensual

• Crecimiento profesional: oportunidades aceleradas de aprendizaje y desarrollo en una empresa de rápido crecimiento

• Excelente ambiente laboral: trabaja con un equipo inspirador y divertido en una cultura que valora la colaboración, el crecimiento y la mentalidad customer-first

• Estar en la primera fila transformando toda la industria del Comercio Moderno

• Seguro médico

• 20 días de vacaciones desde el día 1

• Servicio / Comedor en la oficina

Delinea is a pioneer in securing human and machine identities through intelligent, centralized authorization, empowering organizations to seamlessly govern their interactions across the modern enterprise. It is the only platform that enables you to discover all identities – including workforce, IT administrator, developers, and machines – assign appropriate access levels, detect irregularities, and respond to threats in real-time. With deployment in weeks, not months, 90% fewer resources to manage than the nearest competitor, and a 99.995% uptime, Delinea delivers robust security and operational efficiency without compromise. Learn more about Delinea on Delinea.com, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

Join our passionate, global team at Delinea and help us make the world a safer and more secure place. Our success is driven by world-class product leadership, outstanding engineers, and strategic investment from TPG. We value diversity, innovation, and a culture of respect and fairness. If you're ready to push boundaries and challenge the status quo in security, we want to hear from you.

Apply today to help us achieve our mission.

Role Summary

This is an execution-focused role within an AI-first operating model: automation handles detection, matching, and research at scale, and the Analyst reviews AI-flagged findings, conducts hands-on research, and makes or recommends the final changes to Salesforce. The Analyst is the front line for hierarchy accuracy, deduplication, sanctions screening, and account-creation gatekeeping, and works closely with the Manager to flag risks, escalate exceptions, and continuously improve team workflows.

This role is hybrid in Mexico City (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday) at our office in Reforma.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities


 Execute day-to-day maintenance and updates of account hierarchy relationships in Salesforce, with particular attention to US Federal, Strategic, and Enterprise accounts.
 Investigate and resolve flagged duplicate account and contact records using data-quality tooling (for example, Openprise, Validity/DemandTools, Cloudingo), following the team's deduplication standards.
 Research and validate parent-child account relationships to support a single, accurate source-of-truth customer hierarchy.

OFAC / Sanctions Screening

 Escalate flagged matches promptly to the Manager and Legal/Compliance, following defined escalation and resolution procedures.
 Research and validate new account creation requests in Salesforce, confirming correct placement within the customer hierarchy before account creation.
 Meet established SLAs for account research and creation turnaround time.
 Flag ambiguous, high-risk, or unclear account creation requests to the Manager for review and guidance.


AI-First Tooling & Continuous Improvement


 Use AI and automation tools for detection, matching, and research; review and validate AI-flagged findings before making or recommending changes to transactional systems.
 Provide feedback on tooling accuracy and performance to support continuous improvement of the AI-first operating model.
 Identify recurring data quality issues or process gaps and recommend improvements to the Manager.


Qualifications


 1–3 years of experience in data governance, data quality, or Salesforce data operations.
 Direct, hands-on experience with the Salesforce account/contact data model.
 Familiarity with data quality/deduplication tooling (e.g., Openprise, Data.com, Cloudingo, Validity/DemandTools) preferred.
 Basic familiarity with OFAC/sanctions screening processes, or a strong ability to quickly learn compliance-driven workflows.
 Detail-oriented and comfortable operating within SLAs and a controls-oriented environment.
 Demonstrated interest in applying AI/automation tools to data quality or operations workflows.
 Fluent English required; based in Mexico City.
 Bachelor's degree required.

description:
About the job

Job Description

The Senior Associate, Cyber Operations will join the Cyber Operations / Incident Response team and will be responsible for investigating, managing, and documenting cybersecurity incidents within a 24x7 security operations environment.

Key Responsibilities

Monitor, investigate, and respond to cybersecurity alerts and incidents, identifying potential threats and assessing their impact on the organization.
Manage security incidents throughout the Incident Response lifecycle, including identification, containment, eradication, recovery, and lessons learned.
Investigate security events using Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) technologies such as CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE), Zscaler, or equivalent platforms.
Support threat identification, incident investigation, containment, and remediation activities.
Document incident findings, investigation details, actions taken, and resolution outcomes.
Use ServiceNow or similar platforms for incident ticketing, tracking, and case management.
Support investigations related to email security threats such as phishing and malicious emails using tools such as Proofpoint or equivalent technologies.
Leverage Threat Intelligence platforms, such as Recorded Future or equivalent solutions, to identify Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) and support incident investigations.
Work within a predominantly Microsoft Azure environment and support security monitoring and incident response activities across cloud-based systems.
Use scripting, preferably Python or Shell Script, to automate small repetitive security tasks when applicable.
Support security automation and orchestration activities using Cortex XSOAR or equivalent SOAR platforms when required.
Stay current with cybersecurity threats, technologies, and security practices and contribute to continuous improvement of incident response processes and controls.

Job Requirements

Must-have

3–5 years of hands-on experience in Cybersecurity Incident Response / Incident Management.
Experience investigating and responding to cybersecurity alerts and incidents.
Hands-on experience with EDR technologies, such as CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE), Zscaler, or equivalent platforms.
Solid understanding of the Incident Response lifecycle: Preparation, Identification, Containment, Eradication, Recovery, and Lessons Learned.
Ability to document incidents, investigations, actions taken, findings, and outcomes.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
Availability to work rotating schedules according to operational needs, with schedule changes approximately every quarter.
Availability to work 100% remotely.

Preferred / Nice to Have

Experience with ServiceNow for security incident ticketing and case management.
Experience working in Microsoft Azure environments; approximately 80–90% of the current environment is Azure-based.
Basic scripting experience, preferably Python; Shell Script is also valuable.
Experience with Proofpoint or equivalent email security platforms.
Experience with Recorded Future or other Threat Intelligence platforms, including working with Indicators of Compromise (IOCs).
Experience with Cortex XSOAR or another SOAR platform for security automation and orchestration.
Exposure to Threat Hunting and Digital Forensics.

Preferred Certifications

Certifications are desirable but not mandatory. Particularly valued certifications include:

GCIH – GIAC Certified Incident Handler
GCFE – GIAC Certified Forensic Examiner
GCFA – GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst
Microsoft Azure certifications, such as AZ-900 – Microsoft Azure Fundamentals

Other relevant cybersecurity certifications may also be considered.

About the job

About Lambdac




Lambdac is a scientific consulting company providing expert guidance and support across scientific and technical fields. We work with clients to solve complex problems, optimise processes and support data-driven decision-making, collaborating with specialists and leaders across disciplines on long-term client relationships.




The role




Hybrid, based in Mexico City, with client visits within the city and occasional travel within Mexico.

The Commercial Scientific Associate sits at the point where scientific products meet the commercial and financial side of the business.

You will develop and manage client relationships while ensuring that the commercial and financial information behind those relationships remains accurate, organised and up to date.

On the commercial side, key responsibilities include:

Identifying and following up on opportunities with laboratories, hospitals, distributors and other healthcare or scientific organisations.
Developing and maintaining relationships with existing and prospective clients.
Preparing quotations, commercial proposals and supporting documentation.
Presenting scientific and diagnostic products with enough technical depth to communicate credibly with laboratory professionals and other technical buyers.
Following up on quotations, proposals, orders and commercial opportunities.
Maintaining an accurate and structured sales pipeline.
Coordinating internally to ensure that client requests and commercial commitments are followed through.
Supporting business development activities and identification of new opportunities.
Maintaining organised records of client interactions, opportunities and commercial activities.

On the financial and operational side, key responsibilities include:

Preparing and following up on invoices.
Monitoring collections and outstanding payments.
Tracking orders from purchase through import, delivery, invoicing and payment.
Reconciling transactions and maintaining accurate financial records.
Supporting pricing and margin analysis.
Maintaining visibility over costs, sales prices and commercial margins.
Preparing regular financial and commercial reports.
Coordinating information related to purchase orders, suppliers, imports and client payments.
Maintaining structured databases in Notion and helping improve the processes behind them.

The role requires both commercial initiative and strong operational discipline. We are looking for someone who can build a client relationship, understand the scientific context of the products being discussed, and at the same time make sure that quotations, invoices, payments, orders and internal records remain accurate.




What we are looking for




Degree in a life science, chemistry, biotechnology or a related scientific field.
Additional education or training in business, finance, sales or commercial management is considered a plus.
Experience in sales, business development, account management or client-facing roles, ideally involving scientific, diagnostic, laboratory or medical products.
Ability to understand scientific or technical products and communicate their value clearly to technical customers.
Working knowledge of invoicing, collections and basic financial control.
Familiarity with Mexican tax invoicing and CFDI is a strong advantage.
Confidence working with numbers, spreadsheets, pricing and commercial information.
High attention to detail and discipline in maintaining accurate records.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Native or fluent Spanish.
Confidence communicating with clients, suppliers and international partners.
Knowledge of Notion, or a genuine willingness to learn it properly.
Comfort working with digital tools and structured databases.
Ability to coordinate multiple commercial and administrative processes simultaneously.
Understanding of import processes, logistics or healthcare regulatory requirements is considered a plus.

Interest or experience in process automation, data analysis and the practical use of artificial intelligence will also be valued.




AI tools are welcome and widely used at Lambdac. As with all tools, accuracy, judgement and appropriate verification remain the responsibility of the person using them.

Y porque tu familia también es importante para nosotros, ellos también pueden gozar de beneficios como nuestra Línea de Bienestar, miles de Convenios y Descuentos, programas de Becas para tus hijos, Planes de Ayuda para diferentes momentos de vida, entre otros.
description:
About the job

Overview

CARRERAS PARA SONREÍR

En PepsiCo, descubrirás un lugar donde nuestra misión es crear sonrisas alrededor del mundo. Con más de 500 marcas queridas, incluyen Gatorade, Lay's y Quaker y nuestro trabajo llega a millones de personas cada día.

En el corazón de nuestra compañía hay un equipo de pensadores y creadores que colaboran para innovar y convertir las ideas en acciones. Impulsados por la innovación y centrados en crear momentos de alegría a través de los alimentos y bebidas, nuestras decisiones se guían por y para el consumidor, creando oportunidades para que nuestros asociados realicen un trabajo significativo y tengan un impacto duradero en las comunidades a las que servimos.

Sea cual sea tu función, formarás parte de una comunidad global que valora tus ideas y te empodera para que tengas impacto en tu carrera y en el mundo que te rodea.

La oportunidad 

Tu impacto 

Asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos de volumen, distribución, participación de mercado y ejecución en punto de venta, mediante la supervisión, desarrollo y acompañamiento del equipo de vendedores, garantizando una operación eficiente, rentable y alineada a los estándares de PepsiCo.

Responsibilities


Supervisar y dar seguimiento al cumplimiento de metas de venta, indicadores comerciales y KPIs del equipo asignado. 
Coordinar, capacitar y desarrollar al equipo de vendedores para maximizar su desempeño y productividad. 
Acompañar rutas de venta para asegurar la correcta ejecución en punto de venta (precio, exhibiciones, inventario, rotación y servicio). 
Analizar resultados de venta, detectar desviaciones y generar planes de acción correctivos. 
Garantizar la correcta implementación de promociones, lanzamientos y estrategias comerciales definidas por la compañía. 
Asegurar el apego a políticas, procesos y lineamientos operativos de Sabritas. 
Mantener una comunicación constante con áreas internas (logística, almacén, administración y RH). 
Gestionar incidencias operativas, servicio al cliente y seguimiento a cuentas clave. 
Fomentar un ambiente de trabajo basado en seguridad, disciplina operativa y cultura de alto desempeño.


Qualifications

¿A quién buscamos?


Carrera terminada (Se pueden evaluar recien graduados).
Licencia de Manejo (Se aplicará prueba de manejo).
Apasionado por las ventas. y trabajo en campo.
Manejo de base de datos y capacidad de análisis desarrollada.
1 año manejando equipos. (De preferencia).


Si esta es una oportunidad que te interesa, te alentamos a postularte aún si no cumples con el 100% de los requisitos.

Qué puedes esperar de nosotros:


Oportunidades para aprender y desarrollarte todos los días a través de una amplia oferta de programas. 
Plataformas internas digitales que promueven el self-learning. 
Programas de desarrollo de acuerdo con habilidades de Liderazgo. 
Entrenamientos especializados de acuerdo con el rol. 
Experiencias de aprendizaje con proveedores internos y externos. 
Nos encanta celebrar el éxito, por lo que contamos con programas de reconocimiento por antigüedad, comportamientos, liderazgo, momentos de vida, entre otros. 
Programas de bienestar financiero que te ayudarán a alcanzar tus metas en todas las etapas de la vida. 
Un programa de flexibilidad que te permitirá balancear tu vida personal y laboral, adaptando tu jornada laboral a tu estilo de vida. 
Y porque tu familia también es importante para nosotros, ellos también pueden gozar de beneficios como nuestra Línea de Bienestar, miles de Convenios y Descuentos, programas de Becas para tus hijos, Planes de Ayuda para diferentes momentos de vida, entre otros. 


En PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos con impulsar un equipo de trabajo diverso al crear un espacio colaborativo, equitativo e incluyente, en donde todos y todas independientemente de cómo nos vemos, de dónde somos o a quién amamos- tengamos una voz.

Ofrecemos oportunidades únicas para contratar personas calificadas y diversas, independientemente de su género, raza, orientación sexual, religión, nacionalidad, edad o discapacidad.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
skills: Campaign Preparation and Execution: Independently create, schedule, and execute marketing campaigns (email, push notifications, WhatsApp, in-app messages, banners) across multiple customer segments.
Optimize campaigns for delivery across time zones, devices, and customer preferences.
Ensure compliance with legal standards such as GDPR and other regional requirements.
Audience Segmentation: Design and implement custom segmentation strategies based on multidimensional criteria such as behavior, demographics, orders and ride history, and engagement levels.
Maintain dynamic customer segments that update automatically as data changes.
Trigger Campaign Configuration: Build and manage multi-step automated workflows, such as re-engagement, loyalty program adoption, or upselling campaigns, with minimal supervision.
Test and troubleshoot triggers to ensure proper execution and alignment with the customer lifecycle.
Testing and Optimization: Plan, execute, and document A/B and multivariate tests for key campaign elements, including design, timing, and messaging.
Use insights from testing to implement data-driven improvements across campaigns.
Perform regular performance reviews to refine optimization strategies.
Reporting and Analysis: Generate detailed reports on campaign performance, interpreting metrics like open rates, CTRs, conversions, and ROI.
Present data insights to stakeholders and provide actionable recommendations to improve rider and driver engagement.
Collaboration and Mentoring: Collaborate with cross-functional teams (content, design, analytics) to deliver campaigns.
Provide guidance and support to junior CRM specialists, including peer reviews and knowledge sharing.
CRM Platform Proficiency: Independently execute at least five end-to-end campaigns quarterly using advanced CRM platform features (e.g., Bloomreach, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot).
Build at least three advanced automations quarterly, such as multi-step workflows with branching logic (e.g., loyalty or churn prevention campaigns).
Complete at least two courses with intermediate certification for Bloomreach or demonstrate equivalent expertise.
Data Analysis and Reporting: Create detailed reports with data visualizations for at least five campaigns quarterly, incorporating metrics like open rates, conversion rates, and ARPPU.
Work with datasets using tools like Excel or Google Sheets with advanced functions (e.g., INDEX/MATCH, QUERY).
Present campaign insights to stakeholders in three formal presentations with actionable recommendations.
Digital Marketing Expertise: Apply intermediate-level knowledge of digital marketing strategies, including personalization, retargeting, and customer journey mapping.
Assist in the strategic planning of at least two multi-channel campaigns integrating email, WhatsApp, in-app, banners, and push notifications.
Advanced Data Handling: Segment audiences dynamically based on real-time data, using at least three different criteria simultaneously.
Ensure data compliance by implementing processes that align with GDPR/CCPA requirements for all campaigns.
English Proficiency: Write comprehensive campaign briefs and reports in English, ensuring accuracy and clarity.
Lead or co-lead three cross-functional meetings in English, presenting updates or insights confidently.
Advanced Testing and Optimization: Conduct and analyze A/B tests for at least five campaigns quarterly, including testing subject lines, offers, layouts, and timing.
Implement changes based on test results, achieving measurable improvements in key KPIs (e.g., a 5 statistically significant lift in conversion).
Communication Deliverability: Monitor and resolve deliverability issues for campaigns.
Use tools like Postmaster Tools or delivery reports to troubleshoot spam issues and optimize sender reputation.
Help us challenge injustice by creating fair choices for millions of people across 1100+ cities in 48 countries.
Develop your professional skills with access to mentoring, career consulting, and learning programs.
Collaborate with teams around the world and gain international experience through our Global Talent Exchange Program.
Engage in company-wide challenges, awards, sports activities, employee-led social impact and volunteering projects.
Work alongside people who take initiative, speak openly, and challenge themselves to grow.
Improve your language skills through co-financed courses and internal speaking clubs.
